controls.name: Production Administrative MFA
controls.description: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA/2FA) is strictly enforced for all administrative and developer accounts accessing production infrastructure, source code repositories, and identity providers.

controls.name: Least-Privilege IAM & Role-Based Access Control
controls.description: Production permissions are granted strictly on the principle of least privilege using predefined IAM roles. Write/admin privileges are segregated from read-only service accounts.

controls.name: Rapid Deprovisioning & Access Revocation
controls.description: Access to all systems within the production boundary is revoked within 8 hours of personnel departure or contract termination.

controls.name: Privileged Account Inventory & Break-Glass Access
controls.description: Master inventory of privileged accounts is documented. Emergency break-glass access follows a documented protocol with post-incident credential rotation and audit log review.

controls.name: Quarterly User Access Reviews
controls.description: Formal access audits are conducted quarterly to verify that active users, roles, and API key privileges remain minimal and aligned with current business requirements.

controls.name: Mandatory Peer Review & Branch Protection
controls.description: The main branch is protected. Direct commits are blocked. Every production change requires a documented Pull Request, code review approval, and passing CI validation.

controls.name: Automated CI/CD Quality, Lint & Security Gates
controls.description: Automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline enforces type checking, unit tests, integration tests, boundary security linters, and build verification prior to merging.

controls.name: Deployment Tracking & Change Provenance
controls.description: Every production release is tied to an immutable git SHA, semantic version release tag, and audit log in the deployment pipeline.

controls.name: Emergency Hotfix Protocol
controls.description: Critical security or availability hotfixes may bypass standard review delays but still require automated CI passage, explicit founder authorization, and retroactive 24h peer review.

controls.name: Centralized Secrets Management & Zero-Commit Policy
controls.description: Production API keys, private tokens, and database credentials are stored exclusively in Google Cloud Secret Manager or encrypted CI secrets. Secret scanning actively blocks repository commits.

controls.name: Frontend API Boundary & Token Isolation
controls.description: Client applications (web/Electron) never hold long-lived server secrets or provider master keys. Requests route through authenticated Cloud Functions/backend proxies.

controls.name: Data-at-Rest Encryption
controls.description: All artist audio files, metadata, documents, and credentials at rest are encrypted using Google-managed or customer-managed AES-256 encryption.

controls.name: Data-in-Transit Encryption
controls.description: All network communications in transit are encrypted via TLS 1.3 / TLS 1.2 minimum with strict cipher suites. HTTP is automatically redirected to HTTPS with HSTS enabled.

controls.name: OAuth Token Storage & Revocation Architecture
controls.description: Third-party OAuth tokens (e.g. Meta, Spotify) are encrypted at application level, isolated to private backend subcollections, and validated with state parameters, signature verification, and instant revocation hooks.

controls.name: Data Classification Policy & Tiering
controls.description: Data is formally categorized into Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted. Storage, access controls, logging, and destruction rules are defined and enforced per tier.

controls.name: Artist Audio Vault Isolation & Access Control
controls.description: Unreleased artist audio files and stem vaults are treated as Confidential/Restricted assets. Storage rules strictly isolate tenant namespaces; signed URLs have short TTLs (<=15 mins).

controls.name: User Account Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten
controls.description: User account deletion triggers cascading deletion of tenant audio files, metadata, AI conversation history, and credentials within 30 days, leaving an anonymized tombstone record.

controls.name: Data Retention Schedule Enforcement
controls.description: Temporary audio render cache, sidecar video files, and ephemeral session data are automatically expired and purged via Google Cloud lifecycle policies.

controls.name: Remote Relay Cryptographic Authentication
controls.description: Remote Studio Executor instances authenticate to the Relay using short-lived cryptographically signed session tokens tied to the verified artist identity.

controls.name: Command Expiration & Nonce Replay Protection
controls.description: Every remote execution payload includes a monotonic nonce, timestamp, and maximum 60-second time-to-live to completely eliminate replay attacks across network boundaries.

controls.name: Studio Executor Audit Trail & Execution Logging
controls.description: Every executed DAW command, script render, or system interaction records structured audit metadata containing actor ID, machine signature, execution status, and timestamp.

controls.name: Structured Audit Event Logging
controls.description: Meaningful operations (auth events, data export, role change, audio download, credential update) emit structured audit logs with actor ID, organization ID, action, resource, and status. Sensitive data is redacted.

controls.name: Production Log Retention & Tamper-Resistance
controls.description: Production audit and access logs are retained in append-only Google Cloud Logging storage for a minimum of 365 days with Object Lock / Bucket Lock to prevent tampering or deletion.

controls.name: Real-Time Security Alerting on Privileged Operations
controls.description: Real-time alerts fire immediately on suspicious activity: excessive failed logins, IAM role modifications, administrative break-glass events, and anomalous data egress spikes.

controls.name: Automated Dependency Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Dependabot and npm audit run continuously on pull requests and on a weekly schedule. Alerts automatically generate issues and PRs for vulnerable dependencies.

controls.name: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) & Linters
controls.description: Custom boundary linters and ESLint security plugins block unescaped frontend secrets, disallowed third-party API hosts, and insecure cloud function routes during CI.

controls.name: Vulnerability Remediation SLAs
controls.description: Identified vulnerabilities follow strict remediation SLAs: Critical <= 24 hours, High <= 7 calendar days, Medium <= 30 calendar days, Low <= 90 calendar days.

controls.name: Documented Incident Response Plan & Runbook
controls.description: A formal Incident Response Plan details detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, customer notification, and postmortem analysis workflows.

controls.name: Incident Response Tabletop Simulation
controls.description: Annual simulated incident exercises (e.g. leaked OAuth credential, compromised audio bucket) are conducted to test escalation paths, containment speed, and communication readiness.

controls.name: Postmortem Review & Corrective Action Tracking
controls.description: Every P0/P1 security or operational incident results in a blameless postmortem within 5 business days, identifying root causes, timeline, and corrective preventive actions.

controls.name: Multi-Zone Cloud Redundancy
controls.description: Production Firestore database is deployed in a multi-region configuration; Cloud Functions/Run workloads automatically distribute traffic across multiple availability zones.

controls.name: Automated Daily Backups with Point-in-Time Recovery
controls.description: Automated daily snapshots of Firestore collections are captured and retained for 30 days. Cloud Storage buckets enforce object versioning with 30-day noncurrent version retention.

controls.name: Periodic Backup Restoration & Integrity Testing
controls.description: Database and audio storage backups are restored to an isolated staging environment at least semi-annually to verify backup integrity, data consistency, and recovery mechanics.

controls.name: Defined RPO & RTO Performance Metrics
controls.description: Recovery Point Objective (RPO <= 1 hour) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO <= 4 hours) are formally documented, reviewed annually, and validated against disaster recovery drills.

controls.name: Third-Party Vendor Inventory & Criticality Assessment
controls.description: All third-party software, cloud infrastructure, and API providers handling customer or production data are inventoried with documented business purpose and risk tier.

controls.name: Annual Vendor Security & SOC 2 Attestation Review
controls.description: Critical vendors (Google Cloud, GitHub, Meta, AI providers) are reviewed annually to verify current SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certifications, or equivalent security audits.

controls.name: Annual Risk Assessment & Register Maintenance
controls.description: An enterprise risk assessment is performed at least annually to identify, score, and mitigate technical, operational, and organizational security risks.

controls.name: Threat Modeling for High-Risk Subsystems
controls.description: Threat modeling (STRIDE methodology) is conducted and maintained for critical architectural components handling artist IP, remote command execution, or third-party credentials.

controls.name: Personnel Security Agreements & Background Vetting
controls.description: All employees, contractors, and contributors sign confidentiality agreements and intellectual property assignments prior to receiving access to repositories or infrastructure.

controls.name: Annual Security Awareness & Phishing Training
controls.description: Team members undergo annual security awareness training covering phishing defense, password/passkey management, social engineering, data classification, and incident reporting.

controls.name: Acceptable Use & Workstation Security Baseline
controls.description: Developer machines accessing production or source repositories must enforce full-disk encryption (FileVault/BitLocker), automatic screen locks (<=10 mins), and OS auto-updates.
